historical_record.description: Built as the Hotel Garland, stores and mid-priced hotel with 85 rooms and 73 baths, to the design of the architects Hladik and Thayer. Six storeys over a basement, reinforced concrete structure, three-part vertical composition, Renaissance/Baroque ornamentation.
